alternatives.name: parallel2word protected calendar PRIMARY
alternatives.host_install: double256-bit programme words; 8LE32data writes perword; begin and full-image commit wait actual tagged ACK. Installation outside block-ready/execution epochs.
alternatives.execution: parallel same-PC reads; predictedII1, first calendar start input+4/read input+2. No multiplexing cycle penalty. Native component gate required.

alternatives.name: one calendar plus separate fixed PV/service context controller
alternatives.host_install: additional explicitly configured service/PV descriptors/context. Format, count and installer costs depend on actual source; no zero-byte assumption.
alternatives.area: needs new per-bank epoch/tag/counter and deterministic PV/service dispatch logic or a separately priced context programme; unimplemented and unmapped. Shared PV stager state is required by either alternative and is not counted as an advantage.
